The '''Vaydean Marsh''' was a vast marsh on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It bordered the [[Narmle Bog]]. The city of [[Restuss]] was built in the Vaydean Marsh.<ref name="SWG" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Vaydean Marsh are one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
